title: Comic Book Research Lab
text:
CBRL brings precision measurement and causal analysis to collectible comics, revealing their material condition, investigating deterioration, and informing preservation decisions.
OUR RESEARCH OUR SERVICES


COLLECTION DECISIONS Helping you make informed choices about acquisition, storage, and care.
DATA-DRIVEN CONDITION ASSESSMENT Helping us all understand measurable properties beyond visible appearance.
DATA-DRIVEN APPRAISALS WITH NO CONFLICT OF INTEREST Appraising current and predicted condition of valuable comics.
SCIENTIFIC DISCOVERY Advanced, data-driven causal modeling of how comic books age and deteriorate.

A Shared Commitment
Comics connect people, ideas, and eras. CBRL works at the intersection of science and culture to help understand and preserve these physical artifacts.
